race.comment: RICH STAR (4) is a very honest sprinter who led all the way to record a gutsy win last start over 1200m at Coffs Harbour. Yet to race beyond that distance which is the query but his record of three wins and four placings from eight runs at Grafton is hard to ignore. Trust him to get the trip and play a key role again. DO IT FOR YOU (2) returned to the winner's list last time out with a comfortable victory in this grade over 1300m at Ballina. Goes up three kilos but he loves racing here and has drawn ideally so another big run looks likely. GOLDEN COPPER (7) made it two wins from her last three runs when she led all the way and easily accounted for an open class field over 1450m at Kempsey recently. Grand veteran who is a chance again with just 0.5kgs more. VOLCANIC LOVE (6) flashed home to finish fourth behind RICH STAR when resuming over 1200m at Coffs last start. Serious contender over the extra 200m. GHOST WALKER (3) just missed at Armidale last time and is also in the mix.
